15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

263349|f9f7abf6.name: James Battlewing
263349|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N. Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

79358-accept.name: Veyric Thunderhame
79358-accept.text:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $N. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358-accept.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

96264-complete.name: Veyric Thunderhame
96264-complete.text:
Interestin'. The quilboar plan tae flood the Thousand Needles, eh? Those good fer nothin' beasts never did respect the elements. With abuse of this magnitude, it's no wonder we can feel it from here.

Ye did good findin' the source of this threat, $N, but now we gotta put an end to it.
96264-complete.title: Elemental Aid
